protocol: Store holdouts only. A taxonomy-association priority list is fitted on the other stores with backfilled cell medoids and with pooled values, and predicts every held-out product; the base rows stop there. The other rows also use the tags and store membership of the held-out products, never their labels. Within one store, each tag with no fitted coefficient takes the medoid of the predictions of the products that carry it, and a product with no fitted tag takes the value of its tightest valued tag: lowest mean distance from those predictions to their medoid, ties to the tag on more products, then the tag name. One round uses only products the fitted list covers; the full version repeats from the newly predicted products until nothing changes. The vote row takes the 71-adic medoid of a product's valued tags instead. The store default gives remaining products the medoid of the predictions on the store's covered products. The fold-scope row pools all held-out stores of a fold. The local-first row runs one round and also lets a covered product take the value of its tightest unfitted tag. The store-consensus row gives that store default to every product of the store. Four oracle rows are diagnostics that read held-out labels and are not predictors: the best single code for each store's uncovered products; the store default and the full tag passing computed from the true labels of the store's covered products; and, for every product, the medoid of the labels of the store's other products. Folds have equal weight.
